subject.title: feat(plugins): add Control UI entry points

question: Should OpenClaw add `registerControlUiEntryPoint` as a separate public plugin UI API, or fold the launch-token behavior into the existing `surface: "tab"` descriptor seam with iframe-only sandboxing?
rationale: This PR defines a durable plugin SDK, Gateway protocol, and authenticated browser execution boundary; automation can point to unsafe paths, but maintainers must choose the permanent API and trust model before external plugins rely on it.

options.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
options.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

options.title: Approve Separate API After Hardening
options.body: Keep `registerControlUiEntryPoint`, but require iframe-only opaque sandboxing, fail-closed launch errors, focused compatibility docs, and exact-head proof before merge.

options.title: Pause For RFC Consolidation
options.body: Leave this PR open while the broader native plugin page and Control UI contribution RFCs settle the long-term browser model.

recommendation.title: Fold Into Tab Descriptor
recommendation.body: Extend the existing plugin tab descriptor contract with launch-token behavior, keep plugin pages sandboxed, and avoid a parallel public API.

likelyOwner.reason: Their merged host-hook foundation and open Control UI contribution RFC are the closest history for the API-shape decision.
